scholarships.name: International Merit Award
scholarships.description: Tuition waiver for international students with strong academic record (GPA 3.60+) or exceptional service. Renewable up to 3 years.
scholarships.descriptionRu: Tuition waiver для международных студентов с сильной академической успеваемостью (GPA 3.60+) или выдающимися достижениями. Продлеваемая до 3 лет.

scholarships.name: International Academic Award
scholarships.description: Automatic tuition waiver for admitted international undergraduates — Level 1 ($4,000) for 3.60+ GPA, Level 2 ($2,000) for 3.0-3.59 GPA.
scholarships.descriptionRu: Автоматический tuition waiver для зачисленных международных бакалавров — Level 1 ($4,000) при GPA 3.60+, Level 2 ($2,000) при GPA 3.0-3.59.

scholarships.name: WUE Distinguished Cougar Award
scholarships.description: Award for high-achieving non-Washington residents with GPA 3.7-4.0. Renewable for 3 additional years.
scholarships.descriptionRu: Стипендия для абитуриентов из других штатов США с GPA 3.7-4.0. Продлеваемая на 3 года.

scholarships.name: Distinguished University Achievement Award
scholarships.description: Merit award for students with 3.8+ unweighted high-school GPA. Renewable annually.
scholarships.descriptionRu: Merit-стипендия для студентов с GPA школы 3.8+. Продлеваемая ежегодно.

scholarships.name: National Merit Scholarship
scholarships.description: Full tuition waiver for National Merit semifinalists. Renewable for 3 additional years.
scholarships.descriptionRu: Полный tuition waiver для National Merit semifinalists. Продлеваемая на 3 года.

scholarships.description: US government's flagship international exchange scholarship covering tuition, stipend, and travel for graduate study at WSU.

paragraphs: Washington State University is a public land-grant research university founded in 1890 with its flagship campus in Pullman, in the rolling Palouse hills of southeastern Washington. WSU is classified by Carnegie as a doctoral university with Very High Research Activity (R1) and brought in $403 million in research expenditure in FY 2024.

The university comprises 11 academic colleges spanning Agricultural, Human, and Natural Resource Sciences; Arts and Sciences; Carson College of Business; Edward R. Murrow College of Communication; College of Education; Voiland College of Engineering and Architecture; College of Nursing; College of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences; College of Veterinary Medicine; Elson S. Floyd College of Medicine; and the Honors College.

WSU enrolls 25,477 students across six campuses — Pullman, Spokane, Tri-Cities, Vancouver, Everett, and the Global Campus — with 4,077 graduate and professional students. The Pullman campus is famous for its Cougar athletics, the Murrow College of Communication, and historic agricultural and viticulture programs.

International students enter via direct admission with standardized test scores and TOEFL/IELTS, with automatic merit awards for qualifying applicants. WSU is known for Veterinary Medicine, Viticulture and Enology, Communication, and Engineering.
paragraphsRu: Washington State University — государственный land-grant исследовательский университет, основан в 1890 году, флагманский кампус в городе Pullman среди холмов Palouse на юго-востоке штата Вашингтон. WSU имеет Carnegie-классификацию doctoral university с Very High Research Activity (R1) и $403 млн расходов на исследования в FY 2024.

Университет состоит из 11 academic colleges: Agricultural, Human, and Natural Resource Sciences; Arts and Sciences; Carson College of Business; Edward R. Murrow College of Communication; College of Education; Voiland College of Engineering and Architecture; College of Nursing; College of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences; College of Veterinary Medicine; Elson S. Floyd College of Medicine; Honors College.

В WSU 25,477 студентов на шести кампусах — Pullman, Spokane, Tri-Cities, Vancouver, Everett и Global Campus — из них 4,077 магистрантов и аспирантов. Pullman знаменит спортивной командой Cougars, Murrow College of Communication и историческими программами по агрономии и виноделию.

Международные студенты поступают напрямую с результатами стандартизированных тестов и TOEFL/IELTS. Автоматические merit-стипендии для подходящих абитуриентов. WSU силён в Veterinary Medicine, Viticulture and Enology, Communication и Engineering.
